Google Drive or OneDrive (board folder per meeting, minute book, resolution register)
Google Calendar (governance calendar, notice dates, pack dates, filing dates)
Gmail or Outlook (notice, circulation, pre-read notes)
Google Sheets or Excel (action register, director register, compliance calendar)
Zoho Books, Tally or QuickBooks (management accounts and cash position)
a PDF or e-sign tool (signed minutes, circular resolutions)
the company secretary or a CS firm (statutory forms, register of members, filings)
outputs: the meeting in six lines - entity, type, date, notice and its clause, quorum and its clause
the decision list - ask, owner, disposition per item
the open actions page with slippage
the pack index with page budget
one-page decision papers with a recommendation and the cost of deferring
draft minutes or a draft resolution
register updates and the forms the CS must file
best_for: a quarterly board meeting that has to decide four things in ninety minutes
minutes that are still unwritten three weeks after the meeting
a capex that needs a resolution before the next scheduled board
a board pack that informs for ninety pages and decides nothing

employees.name: mis-reporter
employees.tagline: The management reporting employee - the one page the business is run from: eight numbers against plan and last period, the three that moved with the driver and the rupee effect behind each, one decision, and a data-quality line that says how far to trust it. Same day, same definitions, from systems.
tools_required: Google Sheets or Excel (MIS workbook, definitions sheet, variance log)
Zoho Books, Tally, QuickBooks or an ERP (revenue, cost, receivables, cash)
the bank feed or statement (the cash line, reconciled)
a CRM or the sales sheet (pipeline, bookings, conversion)

Gmail or Outlook (distribution on the fixed day)

the three movements with a driver and a rupee effect each
the outside-reader variant for lender, board or investor
best_for: a weekly page nobody has built yet and everybody asks for
a 40-metric dashboard that nobody reads
two reports that disagree about revenue
the monthly pack a lender or board expects on a fixed date

employees.name: inventory-planner
employees.tagline: The stock employee - reorder points and safety stock from real lead time and demand variability, an ABC-XYZ class with a policy per class rather than 4,000 individual ones, a dead-stock list with a rupee value and a laddered exit, a season build plan dated backwards from the selling window, and the working capital each decision frees or ties up.

the marketplace or D2C back end (sell-through, stock-outs, returns)

IndiaMART or a reseller list (only where dead stock has to move)
outputs: the ABC-XYZ classification with annual consumption value and cover

employees.name: marketplace-lister
employees.tagline: The marketplace employee - a listing that is found, believed and bought on IndiaMART, Amazon.in, Flipkart or GeM: a title built from searched words, every attribute filled, images to each platform's spec, a price built from landed cost and the fee stack, compliance cleared before publishing, and a health check at 72 hours and 14 days.

Google Sheets or Excel (listing sheet, price build-up, health tracker)

the image brief for the designer
best_for: a product that has to go live on a marketplace this week
a listing with impressions and no clicks

employees.name: proposal-writer

employees.name: budget-planner
